title: Freelance Software Engineer
description:
*Taylor Pancaldi Technology Services* – a company providing custom software solutions for small businesses and freelancers.
- Designed and built **FlexInvoice**, an invoicing tool that generates styled PDF invoices from structured data via server-side rendering and headless Chrome, replacing manual document workflows with automated, repeatable invoice generation.
 - Built as two decoupled services: a stateless **Next.js** rendering API (**Zod** validation, server-side React, **Tailwind**, PDF output) and a **React + Express** client with a form-based GUI, YAML-driven data presets, schema validation, CSV export and **Docker** containerization.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
SaaS startup providing browser-based iOS and Android app simulators, enabling app streaming, automated testing, and embeddable live previews.
- Led the technical implementation of the new [appetize.io](https://appetize.io) marketing website using **AstroJS** as part of a company-wide rebrand, improving Lighthouse performance from **~60% to 90%+** and raising a11y, best practices and SEO scores from **~75% to 95–100%** across core pages.
- Contributed to the **V2 core web application** using **Next.js**, improving UI consistency, usability, and performance while integrating new and existing API endpoints. Expanded E2E test coverage from **50% to 90%+**.
- Did extensive work on the **Stripe billing integration**, keeping the pricing model in sync between the marketing site and the webapp's subscription and payment handling across four plans, each with monthly and annual options. Drove the account page's billing view from **Stripe webhooks**, turning a simple invoice list into a table showing subscription and invoice status with invoice downloads.
- Built a self-serve **enterprise SSO** onboarding flow (**SAML & OIDC**) replacing manual per-tenant database configuration, enabling customers to independently configure identity providers (**Okta**, **Azure AD**) via metadata upload or discovery URLs – removing engineering from the onboarding critical path and saving **30+ hours** of setup effort per tenant.
- Introduced **Google and GitHub authentication**, reducing login friction and improving accessibility for non-enterprise users.
- Eliminated fragile build-ID based URLs by introducing stable **shareable links**, reducing customer support friction and preventing broken embedded demos after app updates.
- Introduced a structured **AI-assisted development workflow** (LLMs for codebase discovery, refactoring proposals and test scaffolding) with guardrails: local context only, no proprietary data exposure, strict review and test validation.
- Contributed to day-to-day delivery through regular **pairing and code review** with teammates.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
B2B SaaS platform offering end-to-end waste management and circularity solutions, helping companies manage disposal, recycling, and compliance.
- Joined the **Recycler API** team, contributing to the maintenance, stability, and reliability of the core platform supporting business-critical waste management workflows.
- Built a production **accounting platform** (**Java/Spring Boot** + **Angular**), used daily by the operations team, replacing manual spreadsheet workflows and supporting reconciliation across thousands of records per day.
- Worked closely with Accounting Operations stakeholders to iteratively refine features based on continuous feedback, translating operational requirements into robust technical solutions.
- Diagnosed and addressed **scaling bottlenecks** in backend services and asynchronous data pipelines. Optimized data access patterns, queries, and job processing, improving API responsiveness and operational stability as data volume grew.
- Served as one of the team's **senior developers**, driving daily **code reviews**, mentoring teammates, and onboarding new joiners with documentation covering the accounting platform's architecture and workflows.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Technology consultancy delivering custom software solutions; worked on **Specsavers'** e-commerce platforms for glasses and contact lenses.
- Maintained and enhanced a large-scale **Drupal**-based e-commerce web application, delivering changes across the full user journey from product discovery to checkout and payment.
- Architected a **GDPR-compliant cookie consent system** across **9 production domains**. Built centralized consent handling and script blocking, deployed behind a **runtime feature flag** to allow staged rollout independent of monthly releases – standardizing compliance and reducing legal exposure on a high-traffic platform.
- Supported the Platform team as both developer and tester in the **containerization** of the application, contributing to improved scalability, portability, and deployment consistency.
- Took on a **senior developer** role within the team, supporting colleagues through **code reviews** and day-to-day guidance, and onboarding new joiners with documentation of the platform and its workflows.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description:
Online platform aggregating car rental providers, enabling search, comparison and booking across multiple suppliers.
- Completed a **rotation-based graduate program**, gaining hands-on experience across backend and frontend teams in a large-scale, high-traffic travel platform.
- Contributed to backend services, including migrating legacy systems to **Spring-based APIs** as part of a broader transition toward **microservices**, and improving integrations with external supplier APIs supporting automated reservations.
- Worked on user-facing features within **Rentalcars.com**, maintaining critical flows such as **payments** and **sanctions screening**, and contributing to the development and rollout of **revenue-generating insurance products**.
- Participated in web replatforming efforts, building **React**-based UI components and search filters integrated into the main application.

title: Research Assistant, project-based Contract
description:
Academic research collaboration across multiple Italian universities.

Co-authored an **IEEE** research article on cloud service contracts and policies, analyzing the implications of **GDPR** and providing guidance for organizational compliance with European data protection regulations.

title: Software Developer, Internship + Contract
description:
Summer internship granting university credits, followed by a 5-month remote collaboration contract.

Implemented a customized **Human Resource Management System** (**HRMS**) according to a client's specific requirements, resulting in an adaptable web portal for efficient management of employee holidays, permits, and sick days.
